raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "happen after"
  role subject "the vendor call"
  role object "the outage"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  speaker "Siobhan"

@q query
  select ?t
  measure start
  where match
    relation "start"
    role subject "the outage"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
